svg.title: Dependency-to-practice index relationships for emerging-technology-enabled tacit knowledge retention
svg.desc: A three-layer relationship map for the bounded s002 industrial sample. Four digitally reconfigured dependency blocks connect to technology-enabled practices grouped by digital codification or experiential amplification and to traditional human-centred practice indexes. Four persistently established dependency blocks condition the same practices. Each dependency block lists its constituent graph IDs.
